messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "carries on well after dose"
set: ["carries on well after dose", "doctor may adjust dose depending on how well you respond to treatment", "well absorbed", "after dose is lowered", "shake the bottle well before every dose", "shake oral liquid well before every dose", "increase dose to 7 mg once daily after 30 days on 3 mg dose", "requirement applies after at least 30 days on 7 mg dose", "increase occurs after at least 30 days on the 4 mg dose", "not feeling well", "dose depends on condition being treated", "doctor will decide on starting dose", "4 weeks after each dose change", "may reduce dose after adding diuretic", "hypotension after initial dose does not preclude dose titration", "increase in 2.5 mg increments after at least 4 weeks on the current dose"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
